# Karajan Code

> The method governor for AI coding agents. Your agent (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode) writes the code; Karajan governs how: a card before the work, tests first, a review by a different AI bound to the exact diff, security and privacy gates, atomic PRs. Git hooks and CI enforce it.

## What Karajan does

1. **Board**: every piece of work is a card (`kj hu add`), local or shared through GitHub issues.
2. **Briefs**: `kj brief <role>` tells your agent what a role (planner, architect, tester, security) must make true.
3. **Review**: `kj review --staged` gets a verdict from a different AI; the commit hook refuses a diff without one.
4. **Gates**: `kj harden` installs the hooks and the Sentinel that keep the method from being skipped.
5. **Lanes**: `kj worktree start <slug>` gives each task its own worktree.

`kj run` and the pipeline it drove were retired in 5.0: see [MIGRATION-v5.md](MIGRATION-v5.md).

## CLI surface (per-command capability docs)

Each entry below is a single fetch under 8 KB tokens.

- [kj plan](docs/agents/SKILL.kj-plan.md) (~3 KB) — list / show / approve / validate plans.
- [kj audit](docs/agents/SKILL.kj-audit.md) (~3 KB) — read-only analysis of any repo: god-functions, missing imports, structure smells.
- [kj doctor](docs/agents/SKILL.kj-doctor.md) (~2 KB) — environment checks + auto-remediation.
- [kj init](docs/agents/SKILL.kj-init.md) (~2 KB) — bootstrap config + review rules + SonarQube.
- [kj board](docs/agents/SKILL.kj-board.md) (~2 KB) — start/stop the HU Board (web UI for plans + sessions). Default bind 127.0.0.1; `--bind 0.0.0.0` exposes on LAN with token auth.
- [kj review](docs/agents/SKILL.kj-review.md) (~2 KB) — cross-AI review of the staged diff (`--staged`), bound to the exact diff.
- Other commands: `kj go`, `kj start`, `kj hu`, `kj brief`, `kj code`, `kj worktree`, `kj rag`, `kj harden`, `kj adr`, `kj report`, `kj config`. `kj advanced` lists them all; see `kj <cmd> --help`.

## Architecture

- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) — architecture and data flow.
- [docs/agents/README.md](docs/agents/README.md) — entry point for AI agents consuming this repo.

## Configuration

- `~/.karajan/kj.config.yml` — global config (the panel: coder/reviewer/solomon providers, model overrides).
- `<repo>/.karajan/coder-rules.md` — per-project rules injected into the coder prompt.
- `<repo>/.karajan/review-rules.md` — per-project rules injected into the reviewer prompt.

## How to extend

- **New agent**: drop a `src/agents/<provider>-agent.js` extending `BaseAgent`, register it in `src/agents/index.js`.
- **New skill**: see [OpenSkills integration](docs/SKILLS.md).

## Key rules for agents driving Karajan

- **Card first**: `kj hu add "<task>"` before the work starts, `kj hu move <id> done` after the merge.
- **Review before each commit**: `kj review --staged`; change the diff and it must be reviewed again.
- Subcommands follow `kj <group> <action>`: `kj hu add`, NOT `kj add hu`. The CLI guard suggests the right form when typo'd.
